_comment: monsterHpPerPlayer = extra max-HP fraction added to monsters per ADDITIONAL party member (0.7 = +70% HP per extra player; a 3-player party faces enemies at x2.4 HP). monsterAttackPerPlayer / monsterDefensePerPlayer / monsterFocusPerPlayer = same scheme for attack/defense/focus (default 0.1 = +10% per extra player). monsterResistFlatPerPlayer = FLAT elemental-resistance increase per extra player as a fraction (0.1 = +10 percentage points; default 0 = no adjustment). monsterResistPercentPerPlayer = PERCENTAGE resistance increase per extra player, applied ONLY to positive resistance (never to weaknesses; default 0 = no adjustment). Clients receive these as hpScale/attackScale/defenseScale/focusScale/resistFlat/resistPercent in the handshakeResponse and apply them with their own party roster size. saveUploadKbS = per-socket save-UPLOAD bandwidth cap in kb/s. Range [1, 65536]; default 16384. saveDownloadKbS = per-socket save-DOWNLOAD pacing in kb/s. Range [1, 65536]; default 16384. port = TCP port the server listens on. Range [1, 65535]; default 15151. The process.env.PORT environment variable, when set, overrides this. playerCollision = whether online players block each other: false (default) = always walk-through (no collision), true = normal collision.
_adminComment: adminToken = 管理界面访问令牌，设为非空字符串即启用 /admin 管理页（空 = 关闭，安全默认）。adminTeleports = 调试面板的传送点预设列表：[{label, map, marker?}]，marker 可省略（落在地图默认出生点）。
